_note: Star Potential (page 2). Segments and stocks are a researched view (Koch's Star Principle: the leader of a niche growing 10%+ a year). Ranking and membership change only at the monthly check or quarterly re-rank, or on a named trigger: pending acquisition, guidance cut, leader clearly losing share, 35% drawdown. Top 3 segments carry 3 stocks, bottom 3 carry 2.

segments.name: OBESITY DRUGS
segments.note: Lilly holds 60%+ of US GLP-1 sales and guides ~25% growth for 2026; Novo guides to a decline and is losing share.

segments.name: AI POWER + COOLING
segments.note: Liquid cooling forecast to grow 21.6%/yr to 2030. Vertiv backlog about $15B, up 109%; trades near 40x forward earnings.

segments.name: DIRECT-TO-PHONE SAT
segments.note: Revenue forecast about $12B by 2030. Starlink leads deployment, AST SpaceMobile leads operator reach; Amazon Leo is buying Globalstar (excluded: price tied to the deal).

segments.name: AI OPTICAL LINKS
segments.note: 800G shipments expected to more than double in 2026. Leader unclear: Innolight (not US-listed) ranked first in 2023; Coherent about 22% share in 2025.

segments.name: MILITARY DRONES
segments.note: Pentagon $1.1B program for 340,000 drones by 2027, but 25 companies compete; no clear leader.

segments.name: GRID STORAGE
segments.note: Growth data is stale (2021 and 2023 forecasts); market shares unverified. Storage is a small part of Tesla.
